description: This file defines functions for resolving extension directories and test plans, counting test files, and creating test shards for a specific project. It imports several external modules and project-specific modules, and contains functions to process extension configurations, test files, and organize test execution shards.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized relative format with forward slashes.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Recursively counts test files (ending with .test.ts or .test.tsx) in a directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for an extension based on input argument or current working directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Builds a test plan for a specific extension, including detection of test files and configuration used.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple test plans into grouped sets based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Generates a batch test plan for multiple extensions, combining their test data.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the fewest total test files and plans for load balancing.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Creates test execution shards to distribute test plans across multiple parallel runs.
